query:
UPDATE course_lessons SET content = REPLACE(
  REPLACE(
    REPLACE(
      REPLACE(
        REPLACE(
          REPLACE(content, 
            '**Sourcing Input Module** (most common in North America):\n- Module provides the positive (+) voltage\n- Field device switches the negative (-) path\n- PNP sensors connect directly',
            '**Sinking Input Module** (most common in North America):\n- Module provides the path to ground (0V)\n- Field device provides the positive (+) voltage\n- PNP (sourcing) sensors connect directly'
          ),
          '**Sinking Input Module:**\n- Module provides the negative (-) return path\n- Field device switches the positive (+) path\n- NPN sensors connect directly',
          '**Sourcing Input Module:**\n- Module provides the positive (+) voltage\n- Field device switches the path to ground\n- NPN (sinking) sensors connect directly'
        ),
        'PNP sensor on sinking input | Input always ON or never ON | Match sensor type to module type',
        'PNP sensor on sourcing input | Input always ON or never ON | Match sensor type to module type (PNP→sinking, NPN→sourcing)'
      ),
      'In North America, most systems use **sourcing I/O** with **PNP sensors**.',
      'In North America, most systems use **sinking input modules** with **PNP (sourcing) sensors**.'
    ),
    'In Europe/Asia, sinking I/O with NPN sensors is more common.',
    'In Europe/Asia, sourcing input modules with NPN (sinking) sensors are more common.'
  ),
  'Mixing them causes inputs that never turn ON or are always ON.',
  'Mismatching sensor output type with module type causes inputs that never turn ON or are always ON.'
) WHERE id = 60011;
